scope: Offline-only MDA selection and downstream assessment for compact Router50 single-Base contracts. The repair makes target availability contract-specific for normalized labels, adds a bounded strict-OOF MDA selector, makes the dual-MC1 diagnostic's warm-up and held months explicit, and adds a full-ET50 compatibility replay for fair historical benchmarking. It does not alter live inference, exchange I/O, admission, portfolio, or execution contracts.

contracts.candidate_identity: candidate_id, UTC decision timestamp, and side; Router50 identities are selected before Base scoring and must remain exact through Base, R/U, and MC1 receipts.
contracts.causality: Base, R/U, and MC1 training use labels resolved before each reserve cutoff; held score receipts are written target-free before policy outcomes are joined for diagnostics.
contracts.features: MDA accepts only a sealed 1..120-field causal contract; MDA permutations act within held decision timestamps and models are fitted once per fold/seed.
contracts.hpo_replay: The bounded HPO receipt records the effective depth-valid leaf count and fold-resolved minimum-child rule, so the full OOF producer can replay exactly the model that HPO evaluated.
contracts.component_attribution: The dual-MC1 diagnostic can now run frozen Base-only, R-only, U-only, and R+U component arms. It changes neither the R/U models nor MC1/HPO/admission/portfolio contracts and is diagnostic-only.
contracts.final_audit: The final audit reads target-free Base/R/U receipts before joining existing policy outcomes solely for diagnostics. It reports capture, component cohorts, residual bands/rescue, and portfolio-risk summaries without fitting or changing any score, admission, or portfolio decision.
contracts.full_et50_compatibility: A frozen single-Base target-free receipt can be replayed through the original cap80/cap120 consensus, generic-correctness, and full dual-MC1 machinery. The compatibility adapter preserves every Router50 row, gives no E/T/R3 slot numerical authority, and never uses outcome columns while materialising its source. Its month parser normalizes either YYYY-MM or full-date CLI inputs to exact UTC calendar-month starts before validating identities.
contracts.outcomes: Canonical policy outcomes are evaluation/training labels only, never scoring inputs; normalized targets use their declared normalized-label availability timestamp.

implementation.outputs: Immutable Base, R/U, and dual-MC1 research artifacts only.

commands: Materialised F1/MDA90, F2/MDA25, and F3/MDA25 all-Router50, target-free 120-field full-ET50 sources (526,912 rows each; 100% field coverage)
Completed full-ET50 compatibility replays for F1/MDA90, F2/MDA25, and F3/MDA25 plus an identical-window ET50 control for May-July 2026
Month-boundary parser check: both YYYY-MM and full-date inputs normalize to exact UTC month starts for the same nine-month range
Validated frozen-HPO receipt loading and depth-valid effective leaf parameters
Reviewed correctness_report.json for F1/MDA90 and F3/MDA25 Base, R/U, and dual-MC1 artifacts
validation.not_run_reason: No live/exchange test is applicable: this receipt covers offline research only.
